
---
### Install
Unsigned builds.

**macOS** — open the `.dmg` for your Mac (`aarch64` = Apple silicon, `x64` = Intel) and drag winfer to Applications. On first launch run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/winfer.app` (or right-click → Open).

**Windows** — run the `-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`); SmartScreen warns because the installer isn't signed: More info → Run anyway.
